author: Martin Luther

notes: Transcription of Luther's Sermon von dem Ablass und Gnade (Leipzig print of 1518), with a facsimile, an English translation, linguistic notes and an introduction, and a note on the variant Basel print. Part of the Taylor Editions 'Reformation' pamphlet collection. The edition is dated 2018 (TEI change date 2018-02-14); the Taylor Editions site is online.
